narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='m1'/>I will use a radius smaller than half of X Y. Smaller arcs are neater!
<bookmark mark='m2'/>The arc from X stops before the middle, and so does the arc from Y.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>They never meet, so there is no point to join.
removed_beats.on_screen: Chintu's bubble shows small arcs from X and Y that stop short of each other; the bubble is struck through in the warning colour

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>Use equal arcs from both ends, more than half the segment, and join the two meeting points.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Your turn. Draw a slanting segment and construct its perpendicular bisector.
